name: A newly made demon, undead, dragonkin or elemental hunter pet can be abandoned and renamed
contract: The client offers Abandon (and Rename) on a pet's portrait menu only when UNIT_FIELD_BYTES_2 byte 2 carries UNIT_CAN_BE_ABANDONED (and UNIT_CAN_BE_RENAMED). Pet::LoadPetFromDB sets both for every hunter pet, but Pet::CreateBaseAtTamed set them only for beasts, so a Hero's starter demon from Summon Demon, a wardrobe cosmetic pet and a tamed non-beast came out without them.

Without the flag the client offered Dismiss instead, which sends COMMAND_ABANDON: the server deleted the pet, and the next call granted a fresh starter, losing any cosmetic pet. After dismissing with the spell and calling again the pet loaded from the database and had the flag, which hid the fault.
A freshly granted starter demon and a freshly summoned cosmetic demon now both carry both flags (value 3), as does the pet loaded after a dismiss.
